name: beyond_create_development_plan
description: Create an initial-build or change plan. Optional dev_plan_id is generated if omitted; existing identity is rejected. DEV_BUDGET/DEV_DURATION_DAYS are customer goals/upper limits, not forecast results. Default response_detail=compact; use full only when complete saved records are needed. Responses embed current/next-stage guide text and disclose server-generated values; no separate guide query is required.

dev_plan_type.description: Suggested convention when the project/user has none; custom existing values remain valid: {'NEW': 'Initial build', 'CHANGE': 'Change to an existing system'}

plan_status.description: Suggested convention when the project/user has none; custom existing values remain valid: {'DRAFT': 'Being prepared', 'ACTIVE': 'In progress', 'DONE': 'Completed', 'ON_HOLD': 'Paused'}

response_detail.description: Compact returns identities and automatic-value receipts without echoing input bodies. Full returns complete saved records.

output_contract_note: No outputSchema is declared by the inspected public source definition. Consult live help and actual results; do not infer a missing output contract.
